correctness.rationale: PASS: The exact cardinality of alternating forms with nullity m is Gaussian-binomial radical choice times |GL_{2r}(q)|/|Sp_{2r}(q)| for n−m=2r; divide by q^{n(n−1)/2} to get the stated mass. First-moment E(q^{M_n})=1+(q^n−1)q^{−(n−1)}<1+q gives uniform geometric tail, so the parity-restricted pointwise limits π_q(m) separately normalize to 1. The EF back-and-forth lemma is justified by matching finite-dimensional spans, radical intersection, pairings and independent symplectic quotient extensions when each symplectic half-rank >=d; it holds even in characteristic 2. Thus a rank-d first-order sentence eventually sees only min(m,d), inducing a finite or cofinite radical-dimension subset F. Every such F is FO definable as a union/negation of finite-dimensional radical conditions, giving exact joint two-parity spectrum and the rad=0 nonconvergence witness. Independent exact arithmetic enumerated all alternating matrices for q=2,n<=5 and q=3,n<=4 and checked nullity frequencies and kernel expectation; these finite checks do not claim to prove EF asymptotics.
